name: station wagon
caption: A station wagon with a long roof, a flat cargo cabin and four wheels. A boxy cabin carries windows and a trunk; four wheels join the chassis. Faceted body panels keep a constant thickness along the chassis. Overall width is 2.30 times depth; height is 0.48 times width. Parts follow functional positions.
